reason: I already pay for Spark, Todoist and Calendly and they work fine together for me. Moving all my client email into another company's cloud to save a few clicks isn't worth tearing up a setup I trust.
objection: I don't want my client email synced to someone else's cloud, and nothing here tells me where it lives or who can see it.
would_change_my_mind: A clear local-only or end-to-end encrypted option for email, so my client mail never sits on Moduo's servers.
